_comment: Temporary allowlist — package @hearst/cockpit-shell v0.2.1 (vendored tarball) contains a stale maroon theme. cockpit.css is the effective runtime source of truth until the tarball is rebuilt. See ADR-014.

allowedDivergences.reason: Package stale (maroon). cockpit.css overrides to brand green #A7FB90 via !important.
Package uses maroon-tinted near-black. cockpit.css uses pure black #000000 for iOS dark mode.
Intentional density tweak — 82% mix gives better legibility on the green accent.
Intentional calibration — 28% is more subtle on the bright green accent; 55% is too loud.
Intentional layout calibration (92px). Unit migrated to rem for scaling consistency.
Intentional layout calibration (380px). Chat rail narrowed for density. Unit migrated to rem.
Intentional lift — 0.02 is imperceptible on pure black. Raised to 0.04 for card readability.
Intentional lift — surfaces lifted ~3pp to be distinguishable on #000000 background.
Intentional lift — same rationale as surface-1.
Intentional lift — same rationale as surface-1.
Intentional readability lift — 0.48 fails WCAG AA on #000000. Raised to 0.70.
Intentional redesign — package shadow was too heavy (20px blur, -24px spread). Replaced with a flatter, quieter drop shadow.
Intentional calibration — 220ms feels less snappy and more premium on glass surfaces.
